canonicalGoalAtReview.titleEn: Build and qualitatively explain a simple electric motor
canonicalGoalAtReview.description: Die lernende Person kann einen einfachen Elektromotor aufbauen, seine Funktion mit der Kraft auf stromdurchflossene Leiter im Magnetfeld erklären und Möglichkeiten zur Variation seines Laufs untersuchen.
canonicalGoalAtReview.descriptionEn: The learner can build a simple electric motor, explain its operation using the force on current-carrying conductors in a magnetic field, and investigate ways to vary its motion.

reviewMethod: Both complete language versions, solutions and all scoring cores manually read; independent numerical and vector calculations plus exhaustive rubric enumeration.
contentReview: Two independently assembled real open motors require fresh observed starts, current reversal in A and field reversal in B, with the other variables held fixed.
Each case requires own spatial current/field/force explanation, torque and commutation, rather than memorized clockwise labels.
A functioning electrically sustained run must be demonstrated in each assembly; manual spinning or exclusively failed starts cannot complete the construction core.

independentCalculations.scopeOfSafetyReview: Content-level plausibility only; no real kit or experiment was tested. The task requires a suitable school kit, teacher inspection, current limit and shutdown on faults.

scopeReview: Only the actual covered atom is a prerequisite. Task course tags equal the covered competence course tags. No irrelevant ordinary prerequisite is added.
limitations: No actual learner execution or human trial has occurred.
This is candidate content review; final release metadata, source scopes and actual projections are checked separately.
